description:
1. This pre-solicitation notice is in accordance with FAR 5.101(c). This is not a Request for Quotation (RFQ), a Request for Proposal (RFP), or an Invitation for Bid (IFB). The Government is not soliciting quotes or proposals at this time.

2. Description:

The 60th Civil Engineer Squadron (CES) at TAFB requires a HVAC Air Handler Replacement. The contractor shall provide all labor, equipment, tools, material, supervision, and any other items necessary to properly remove and replace old Carrier air handler unit with a new AHU unit with estimated 3,500CFM capacity to meet the heat/cool load requirements desired.

See Statement of Work for full requirement details.

3. Procedures for Award:

The Government intends to issue a Request for Quotation (RFQ) and award a firm-fixed-price Purchase Order. The award basis is anticipated to include Past performance and Price. The Government anticipate to award on or about 02 May 2026.

  1. Trade Agreements Language: Not Applicable.
  2. Technical Data: Not Applicable
  3. Construction Contract Information: Not Applicable
  4. Statement Regarding Responsible Sources: All responsible sources may submit a quotation, bid, or proposal, as appropriate, which will be considered by the agency.
  5. Competitive Status: This is a competitive action 
  6. Qualification Requirement: See SOW.
